description: index.default_pipeline of vendetta-alerts-*. OpenSearch 2.17 ignores the _bulk ?pipeline= parameter for update + doc_as_upsert actions (only the index default pipeline runs on the upserted doc), so this router picks the transform by record shape: a raw SARIF result (ruleId) -> sarif-to-vendetta-alert; an AIIncidentAnalysis / cs3.ai.inference event (severityAssessment, top level or under analysis) -> aiincident-to-vendetta-alert; native Vendetta alerts and partial updates (rule is an object, no ruleId / severityAssessment) pass through untouched. An explicit ?pipeline= on an index/create request overrides this default. On failure the document is kept and ingest_error is set.

pipeline.description: Raw SARIF result shipped by errow-shipper (CONTRACT s15).
pipeline.name: sarif-to-vendetta-alert

pipeline.description: AIIncidentAnalysis (CONTRACT s4.2), bare or wrapped in a cs3.ai.inference event.
pipeline.name: aiincident-to-vendetta-alert
pipeline.if: (ctx.analysis instanceof Map && ctx.analysis.severityAssessment != null) || (ctx.severityAssessment != null && !(ctx.rule instanceof Map))
